dims_mm.note: Official size 226 x 90 x 28.5 mm (37.5 mm at the controller), screen closed. The screen slides up and tilts up to 30 degrees to show the keyboard.

slots.note: M.2 2280 PCIe 4.0 SSD; supports single-sided drives up to 4TB

ports.note: SD 7.0 TF card slot, read speed up to 700 MB/s

screen.note: 368 PPI, 120% sRGB volume, 100% sRGB, 85% DCI-P3. Adjustable screen angle.

controls.stick_note: Hall sensing joystick with RGB lighting
controls.note: Linear Hall triggers, 7.5 mm travel. Six-axis gyroscope. QWERTY keyboard with Fn keys and RGB lighting under the sliding screen. The official spec sheet lists no touchpad.

cooling: "3+2" triple copper tube cooling (fan, three copper heat pipes, two copper sheets)
notes: Only a Ryzen 7 7840U model was found. Max TDP 28 W. The official interface list shows two USB4 ports and a TF slot; no 3.5 mm jack is listed. Launch prices for 16GB/512GB: early bird $699, Indiegogo $799, retail $899. Release date is the AYANEO plan to start shipping in December 2023; NotebookCheck reported DroiX retail stock on 2023-12-20 with a general launch on 2024-01-15. The Antec Core HS is a rebadged Slide (separate brand).
